feature_descriptions.nexus powers: Bound Nexus powers unlock at the published levels and expend souls from the live Bound Nexus pool.

resources.name: Bound Nexus Souls
resources.description: Available souls equal 3 + casting ability modifier (minimum 1) and replenish with spell points.

resources.name: Channel Energy
resources.description: Daily uses equal 3 + Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Positive or negative energy is fixed by the first-level choice.

resources.name: Channel Energy Dice
resources.description: Channel Energy heals or harms 1d6 at 1st level plus 1d6 every two levels thereafter.

resources.name: Nexus Save DC
resources.description: Save DC for Bound Nexus abilities: 10 + half Soul Weaver level + casting ability modifier.

choice_providers.label: Channel Energy and Mastery
choice_providers.description: Choose positive or negative energy at 1st level. This also determines whether Master of Life and Death grants the Life or Death sphere.

choice_providers.label: Blessings
choice_providers.description: Positive channelers choose one Blessing at 2nd level and every four levels thereafter; prerequisites remain enforced by the published sequence.

choice_providers.label: Blights
choice_providers.description: Negative channelers choose one Blight at 2nd level and every four levels thereafter; prerequisites remain enforced by the published sequence.

notes: Spell points use the shared sphere service. Souls and Channel Energy are live rest-recovering resources; their powers and Blessing/Blight selections use the shared class-choice system.
